title: The maximum number of odd cycles in planar graphs forbidding shorter odd cycles
summary: Given a graph $H$ and a family of graphs $\mathcal{F}$, the generalized planar Turán number $\mathrm{ex}_\mathcal{P}(n, H, \mathcal{F})$ is the maximum number of copies of $H$ in an $n$-vertex planar graph that contains no graph $F \in \mathcal{F}$ as a subgraph. When only induced copies of $H$ are counted, we denote the corresponding generalized planar Turán number by $\mathrm{ex}_\mathcal{P}(n, H^{\mathrm{ind}}, \mathcal{F})$.
